This document lists the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed on an 
 annually bases or 400 hours of operation as indicated by Y1 in the title block.

The first draft is initiated by eng. Sherif Mahrous Omar tested by eng. Nafad 
 Kamel Mahmoud, revised by UEEPCo. quality control general director eng Gamal 
 Abd Elwahab, accepted by technical expert eng. Hassan Elbehiry and approved by 
 eng. Mohamed Gamal Diab Head sector of El-Kureimat power station.

items:
A work 
 permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the 
 suitable safety category.

Safety 
 fence with caution marks surrounding the work area.

Wear standard personal safety and healthy equipment as helmet, safety shoes, 
 rubber gloves, ... etc.
Switch off 380 Volt AC supply to compressor .
Switch off 220 Volt AC control power
Set of wrenches and screwdrivers
Wiping material and cleaning liquid
Oil for crankcase
Spare parts (air filters, oil filter, etc ...)

Change 
 the oil at intervals of 400 operating hours, or every one year which ever 
 comes first.

Remove screw plug 
 to change oil, with oil strainer attached, let the oil drain off in to 
 a container, clean out strainer with solvent, re-insert strainer and screw 
 plug

Fill compressor with new approved oil, approximately 3.5 liters of new oil is 
 required

After the oil change operation is completed the compressor must be started 
 several times in succession since the suction line to the oil pump was emptied 
 during the oil change operation.

Check air filter cartridge, if it is dirty, blow the cartridge out with 
 compressed air from the inside outwards, if paper elements in cartridge are 
 damaged, install a new filter cartridge

The valves of all compressor stages must be inspected and cleaned from all 
 contamination and oily carbon deposits. It is good practice to have a spare 
 set of compressor valves available to speed up the overhaul procedure .

See if there are any cracks, damage and loosening on the air valves, suction 
 and delivery valves.
Remove the valves, and valves cleaned in gasoline or cleaning oil.
When assembling valves, do not tighten one-sidedly.
Supply valves a little oil.

Remove first stage cylinder head, inspect and clean/replace suction valve and 
 outlet supply valve, take great care that the valves are properly seated and 
 the valve retainers are correctly placed and tightened
Be careful to valve plates and valve seats not to damage on their surfaces.

Remove second stage cylinder head, inspect and clean/replace suction valve and 
 outlet supply

Remove a diaphragm and valve seat. Check whether any crack or damage are 
 found on their surfaces, clean /replace correctly and 
 tightened. check whether pistons move smoothly.
Properly clean out oil and water traps below the unloaders.

Switch on compressor to blow out supply lines from carbon deposits for each 
 successive stage.
In the same way blow out the oil cooling lines from oil/water deposits
Check fan wheel and blades, oil pump and all pipe coupling connectors

When all suction and supply lines are connected, test run the compressor, 
 observing the correct gauge pressure for each stage

Check the oil pressure monitor switch, momentarily close the ball cock the 
 compressor must shut down after about 10 seconds
Check the operation of compressor room thermostat, controlling the rooms.
Check the non return valves from the main tank to the compressor unit

Check the compressed air main tank, momentarily opening the bottom drain valve 
 to expel any water.
